analyst.summary: Nava combines a ferro-alloys manufacturing business with a Zambian coal-mining and power-generation operation -- both of which are more commodity-cyclical than the sector classification suggests. The most recent quarter's profit fell sharply, partly due to an unusually high one-off tax charge, but revenue and profit have also been softening for two consecutive quarters on an underlying basis. We rate this a Hold: the tax spike should reverse, but the broader trend needs to stabilise before this looks attractively priced.
